sections.heading: In depth
sections.body: Infiltrating water percolates downward until it reaches saturated rock — an aquifer. Groundwater moves slowly, sometimes over centuries, and feeds springs and wells. record_text:
Key points.
Watershed protection. Protecting the land that feeds reservoirs is cheaper than treating dirty water.

In depth.
Forests and wetlands filter runoff naturally. New York City’s watershed protection famously avoided a multi-billion-dollar filtration plant. Conservation easements keep headwaters intact.
source_note: Sourced: standard hydrology and water-engineering knowledge.

title: The ocean’s role
summary: Oceans hold about 97% of Earth’s water and drive weather through evaporation and currents.

Key points.
The ocean’s role. Oceans hold about 97% of Earth’s water and drive weather through evaporation and currents.

In depth.
